what: Mistake: I re-queued Sri's two lost planner requests with athena retry, then ran 'athena go' on one of them (20261113-181007-baf1) under a 110 s timeout. go started the job in the foreground beside the batch; the timeout killed it, leaving the job marked running with no process.
why: I did not check that go runs the job itself, and I ran it beside a batch, which my own notes say to avoid.
